summary: Example pairing users lola and fernando with each of their group IDs using subelements('groups', skip_missing=True).
questions: What does subelements output look like?

answer_card.title: subelements example
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
users:
  - name: lola
    groups: [1,2,3]
  - name: fernando
    groups: [2,3,4]

users_w_groups: {{ users | subelements('groups', skip_missing=True) }}
# => [[{lola...}, 1], [{lola...}, 2], [{lola...}, 3],
#     [{fernando...}, 2], [{fernando...}, 3], [{fernando...}, 4]]
```
